We are a northern European bank with an international reach. This means that we support our home market customers locally when they do business around the world.

Our home markets

We offer a wide range of leading financial services to corporates and institutions in our home markets:

  • Denmark
  • Finland
  • Norway
  • Austria
  • Estonia
  • Germany
  • Latvia
  • Lithuania
  • Netherlands
  • Sweden
  • Switzerland
  • United Kingdom

Our international offices

Our international network provide the customers from SEB's home markets with a wide range of services.

  • Brazil
  • China and Hong Kong
  • Nice, France
  • India
  • Ireland
  • Luxembourg
  • Poland
  • Singapore
  • Ukraine
  • United States
